reasons: All fifteen whole original images retain continuous painted scenery, clear full jewel silhouettes, complete ceiling line and distinct compact edge instruments. No flat gray render rectangle or clipped board strip is visible.

Portrait and landscape preserve the same central star field and spacing, with score/target, Next columns4/5/6 and Help visibly complete. The quiet header and footer remain subordinate to stars/scenery.

The two actual-clear followup guides are readable and separated from the star rows, with distinct Close and Resume sky/Next shower actions. Portrait and landscape result fixtures retain complete headings, body copy and result actions.
The five independently reset art milestones change restored sails/lighting while retaining the same native playfield composition; no overlapping essential HUD ink is visible in the named frames.

limits: This accepted-main baseline establishes only the named default-text, large-tablet historical-mechanic composition and real rotation/input scope.
It does not establish short-phone landscape, AX5, current Kite4 17000-point objective, full/one-space pressure, selected forecast, six-figure targets or simultaneous current receipt layout.
Fifteen stills do not prove continuous animation, frame pacing, exact receipt age, contact latency or physical-device readability.
No actual VoiceOver, Increase Contrast, Reduce Transparency or minimum-OS acceptance is claimed.
This is not Goal9 candidate acceptance; upcoming accepted-main short-landscape/AXphone and any corrected-source final checks remain separate.
